result:
Round 208 passes: the new fader-drag measurements work and can now fail honestly. This round changed only the perf harness and two docs. Saba's slow-fader bug (SABA-B-5) is still there; the fix is planned for round 209. All the browser checks ran in real Chromium (`browserVerified` and `realVerified` = true). I didn't change any app source.

| Row | Result | Key evidence |
|---|---|---|
| SCOPE-208 | PASS | Same at start and end of my check. 5 granted files modified, nothing untracked; all 1,044 frozen files match their hashes; `app/` unchanged. `stats.ts` and the optional `move-latency.ts` were not touched or created. Doc 164 changed on line 4 only, with the exact R114 text. |
| PERF-RUN-208 | PASS | `npm run test:perf` ran twice, one after the other: both exit 0, 7.2 min each, 266 rows, 18/18 assert rows pass, every row has 3 samples, no `event-share-16` rows left. The 141 count rows are identical across my two runs and A's run3. The pan rows show normal values (1.3–3.5 ms), not the injected ~31 ms. |
| Budgets file | PASS | Assert rows went from 14 to 18, and the only new ones are the 4 liveness rows. No existing assert row changed. All 20 `components-per-commit` rows now have no budget and a note saying they are not the per-move measurement. |
| METRIC-LIVE-208 (my own probe, production build) | PASS | Pan drag with my own injected 30 ms listener: 31.6–31.8 ms when it runs inline, 31.1–31.3 ms when deferred, 1.2–1.3 ms without it. The harness gives the same picture. |
| WINDOW-208 (my own probe) | PASS | Components re-rendered in one commit during the drag: track 83, group 85, master 80, pan 4. The commit after release, and the per-move averages, match the harness exactly at both 1440 and 1280. The slow-fader problem is still present (well above 50 for track, group and master). No audio graph restarts during any drag. |
| DRAG-ENDS-208 | PASS | Every fader moves at both ends of the drag, or starts at its maximum and returns to it. None failed to move. |
| DOC-208 | PASS, one Low | Line 60 now describes the new measurement correctly, every row id the doc cites exists in the budgets file, and the status line waits for my verdict as required. |
| AN-REVIEW-208 | PASS | No `any`, `as` or `@ts-ignore` (the only `as` hits are inside the text "set as the active track"). The injected listener is removed after the liveness check. |
| G208-3 (sign-in protection) | PASS | `/studio-lab` opens without signing in at both sizes. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no audio loaded. The Studio token endpoint returns 401 with no header and 500 with a fake token (the local mock backend wasn't running), and no token is issued. |

The full test suite, typecheck, build, lint, `verify` and the e2e smoke test belong to the root gate; I did not claim them.

**For B:**
- **C-R208-01 (Low):** doc 163 now contradicts itself in lines A wasn't allowed to edit. Lines 16 and 83 still say 161 rows, and line 16 says no timing row is an assert. The pass sequence (lines 24–31) lacks the new liveness step, and the line 74 list lacks the new rows. The line 149 TODO still describes the old plan. Granting these lines in round 209 would be cheap.
- **To approve:** A starts counting at the first move after the mouse button goes down, where the task text said "after the first pointermove". My probe found no commits before that point in any of the 30 drags, so today's numbers come out the same either way. It should be approved before round 209, when it could start to matter.
- **For round 209:** the track and group drags start at their maximum, so they never show the value rising past the start. Round 209's tests may want a drag that starts lower.
- **Already known:** clip gain is the slowest. While playing, 95% of moves take up to 64–73 ms against a 16 ms target. This is the SABA-B-5 problem, not a new bug.

There are no Ableton checks this round, because it is a perf-only round.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- `c-round-208.md`
- `c-round-208.json`
- `c-round-208/` (probe scripts, run outputs, screenshots)
